change_reason: Official-spec correction before any real capture/model execution: WH change 000=no previous race, not zero kg; WE initial state may use announcement 00000000 and must fall back to LOCAL_ACQUISITION timing.
rules: feature_source_time_jst and source_capture_time_jst must be offset-aware and no later than prediction_snapshot_time_jst.
OFFICIAL_ANNOUNCEMENT source time must be no later than capture time.
LOCAL_ACQUISITION source time must equal capture time.
Each feature is fail-closed to approved source kinds.
Each source hash must be independently recomputed from the source manifest.
Outcome fields cannot be used as prediction features.
For 0B14 bulk polling, use only the latest complete 0B14 capture acquired by the prediction snapshot; do not carry forward an event missing from that later complete capture.
AV data division maps only to scratch_exclusion_code: 1=scratch, 2=exclusion.
WE turf and dirt track-condition codes stay separate until current surface is independently snapshot-safe.
WH body-weight code 000 means scratch and must not emit body_weight_kg.
WH body-weight change code 000 means no previous race and must not emit numeric body_weight_change_kg; 999 or blank also must not emit numeric change.

A WE initial-state record with raw announcement code 00000000 may be used only from the latest complete 0B14 capture available at the snapshot. Its timing basis is LOCAL_ACQUISITION, feature_source_time_jst equals source_capture_time_jst, and no earlier synthetic official timestamp may be invented.
